response.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg) FROM (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) as group_avg FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault WHERE oe.expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow) subquery
